# SnapKey Mapper

> Free, open source Android app (MIT) that makes the Snap Key, the side key of OPPO Find X9, X9 Pro and other ColorOS phones, open any app, link or Android intent with a single, double, triple or long press, each gesture able to open something different. No root. It reads the key press from the system log, so it works without Wi-Fi.

- [Home page and setup guide](https://remapsnapkey.com/): what it does, how to install it in a few steps, compatibility, FAQ.
- [OnePlus Plus Key guide](https://remapsnapkey.com/oneplus-plus-key/): what the OnePlus Plus Key can do, what the app adds, short setup and FAQ (English only).
- [What is the Snap Key](https://remapsnapkey.com/what-is-snap-key/): the side key of OPPO phones, what ColorOS lets it do, which phones have it (English only).
- [Shortcut ideas](https://remapsnapkey.com/shortcuts/): what to put on the key (flashlight, ring mode, voice notes, AI assistants, music, notes, smart home, camera, timers) and how to set each one up (English only).
- [Setup guide with video](https://remapsnapkey.com/setup/): a one-minute video and the 6 setup steps (English only).
- [Source code and downloads](https://github.com/Damien-llado/snapkey-mapper): README, releases with SHA-256, issues.

Compatibility:

- OPPO Find X9 Pro (ColorOS 16, Android 16): works, daily use.
- OPPO Find X9, Find X9 Ultra, Find X9s, Find N6 (ColorOS 16): works with the Snap Key.
- OPPO Find X10, Find X10 Pro Max (ColorOS): works with the Snap Key.
- OPPO Reno 16, Reno 16 Pro, Reno 16 F (ColorOS): works with the AI Snap Key.
- OnePlus 15, 15R, 13s, 13T, Nord 5 (OxygenOS): works with the Plus Key.

Not working on yours? Tell us on GitHub: https://github.com/Damien-llado/snapkey-mapper/issues/new

The app comes with a library of ready-made shortcuts (timer, alarm, camera, maps, music, chats and more), each checked on an emulator.

Privacy: the app collects nothing. The website measures its audience with Microsoft Clarity only if the visitor accepts the consent banner, and asks api.github.com for the star count.

Two editions: the full one sets the log permission up by itself through the phone's own wireless debugging; the lite one has no internet permission and needs one adb command.
